skill.essence_ascendance.running_momentu: Continuous grounded sprinting builds up to +%s%% movement speed over %s seconds.
Stopping drains a full meter over %s seconds. Turns of %s degrees or more in one tick also drain momentum.
Sprint jumps carry earned momentum without building it. Swimming, climbing, flight, riding, and teleports clear it.
At %s%% momentum, grounded sprinting automatically steps over short obstacles up to %s blocks high.
Requires normal collision clearance. Sneaking disables the vault; higher step-height bonuses are preserved.
skill.essence_ascendance.rush.descriptio: An attributed kill fills Running Momentum and prevents its decay for %s seconds.
Further kills refresh the timer instead of stacking. No additional speed bonus; movement-mode changes and teleports still reset momentum.

Repeated hits of the same damage type become progressively less effective; taking a different type begins a new adaptation.
skill.essence_ascendance.adrenaline.desc: Losing more than the generated share of your pre-hit maximum HP in one hit grants a brief movement, ATK-speed and knockback-resistance boost.
skill.essence_ascendance.animal_gift.des: Well-fed adult animals near the player periodically provide their normal renewable products without being harmed.
skill.essence_ascendance.aquatic_body.de: Restores full underwater mining efficiency and clear vision. Swimming speed remains controlled by Swim Speed bonuses and equipment.
skill.essence_ascendance.armor_crack.des: While Frenzy is active, repeated hits against the same enemy progressively reduce its defenses.
skill.essence_ascendance.bonded_companio: Eligible bonded creatures deal more damage, are faster, and have more health and safely catch up by teleporting after falling far behind.
Standing still while facing incoming threats builds damage resistance and knockback immunity; moving or turning drains it.
skill.essence_ascendance.chain_strike.de: A charged lightning attack arcs to additional nearby enemies, losing power with each jump.
skill.essence_ascendance.charged_jump.de: Hold Jump while grounded to store power, then release for a large controllable leap.
skill.essence_ascendance.combustion.desc: Enemies killed while burning explode, ignite nearby enemies, and can begin chain reactions without damaging terrain.
skill.essence_ascendance.containment_fie: While active, nearby explosions damage creatures normally but cannot break blocks, ignite terrain, affect the player, or destroy dropped items.
Reflected damage also strikes nearby hostile creatures for a reduced amount.
Reduce incoming health DMG by a generated percentage. The damage-taken fraction also sets the temporary max-HP cost per prevented DMG. Lost capacity returns empty after combat.
skill.essence_ascendance.death_rush.desc: Below half health, kills grant stacking attack and cast speed; kills near death refresh the entire rush stack.
skill.essence_ascendance.deep_ward.descr: Absorption earned from Soul Ward persists throughout combat and can exceed its normal cap, then decays after combat.
skill.essence_ascendance.desperation.des: Damage rises smoothly as the player's health falls.
skill.essence_ascendance.double_jump.des: Tap Jump once while airborne for a second jump with full directional control.
skill.essence_ascendance.durability_reve: Durability damage builds reversal charge; when full, the next loss instead restores durability.
skill.essence_ascendance.enchanting_insi: Enchanting tables reveal the full result before commitment and preserve the current offers until the inserted item changes.
skill.essence_ascendance.essence_bloom.d: Creature kills can bloom into bonus Essence and experience instead of improving ordinary drops.
skill.essence_ascendance.essence_wings.d: Holding Jump after the jump's apex deploys an equipment-free Elytra-style glide.
skill.essence_ascendance.evasive_current: Continuous intentional movement builds dodge chance; stopping or taking a hit drains the accumulated evasion.
skill.essence_ascendance.explosive_paylo: Ranged and magical projectiles explode on damaging creature impacts, harming nearby eligible creatures without destroying terrain or starting fires. Continuing shots have a limited payload budget.
Holding Jump while airborne enters free flight using stamina that normally recharges only while grounded.
skill.essence_ascendance.feast_reflex.de: Consumes food and drinks much faster. Automatically eats safe hotbar food when needed, including successive meals when injured and hungry.
Prefers the most nutritious safe hotbar food. Never interrupts item use; while healthy, avoids meals that would waste most of their nutrition.
skill.essence_ascendance.fishers_call.de: Consecutive successful catches build a shoal streak that briefly accelerates bites and can produce a second catch; a miss resets it.
skill.essence_ascendance.fishing_instinc: Fish bite sooner, the reel window is wider, and successful catches have improved treasure quality.
skill.essence_ascendance.frenzy.descript: Consecutive successful attacks build attack speed and damage; pausing or missing breaks the chain.
skill.essence_ascendance.friendly_fire_w: The player's melee, projectile, and ability attacks cannot harm allied players or tamed creatures.
skill.essence_ascendance.frostbite.descr: Repeated hits build Chill, progressively slowing and eventually freezing the enemy.
skill.essence_ascendance.guard_amplifier: Successful blocks temporarily strengthen damage reflection; a perfect block immediately reaches maximum strength and refreshes it.
skill.essence_ascendance.guarded_advance: Guarding no longer prevents sprinting, jumping, or stepping over short obstacles, and causes much less movement slowdown.
skill.essence_ascendance.herdkeeper.desc: Nearby passive livestock gather around the player and become ready to breed sooner.
skill.essence_ascendance.homing_projecti: Ranged and magical projectiles curve toward targets close to the player's aim line.
skill.essence_ascendance.hunger_ward.des: Redirects part of incoming health damage into saturation and hunger. The rest reaches health; depleted food cannot absorb damage.
Threats revealed by Threat Sense remain outlined and display their health and armor.
skill.essence_ascendance.hunters_study.d: Repeatedly killing a creature improves the quality/quantity of its ordinary drops.
Reduction in fall damage also provides reduction in all movement based damage.
skill.essence_ascendance.industrious_pre: While active, nearby furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, brewing stands, and similar work blocks process faster.
skill.essence_ascendance.inner_sustenanc: Hunger slowly restores outside combat; at full saturation, passive hunger drain stops, sleep becomes optional, and phantoms ignore the player.
Taking or dealing hostile damage pauses hunger recovery. Full hunger and saturation protect against passive drain; deliberate hunger costs still apply. You may still use a bed.
skill.essence_ascendance.interceptor.des: Ready ordinary melee attacks destroy supported hostile projectiles intersected by the forward weapon swing.
skill.essence_ascendance.kindling.descri: Repeated hits build Heat; full Heat ignites the enemy and increases damage taken while burning.
skill.essence_ascendance.lavaborn.descri: Extends swimming and clear vision to lava. Immersion causes no contact damage, and lava cannot set you on fire; unrelated fire remains dangerous outside lava.
skill.essence_ascendance.life_steal.desc: Direct weapon damage restores health, with consecutive hits on the same target increasing the healing until the attack chain breaks.
Only confirmed direct weapon hits heal. Changing targets, a missed melee attack, or waiting too long breaks the chain.
skill.essence_ascendance.metabolic_conve: Excess healing replenishes hunger and saturation, while food eaten at full hunger restores health.
skill.essence_ascendance.mining_momentum: Uninterrupted mining, especially through the same material, steadily builds mining speed until the rhythm breaks.
While sprinting with momentum, the player automatically vaults short ledges, fences, and similar obstacles without breaking stride.
skill.essence_ascendance.natures_boon.de: Mined stone, netherrack, end stone, or an equivalent dimension-native material can occasionally drop an ore from that dimension.
skill.essence_ascendance.ore_sight.descr: While holding a pickaxe, nearby natural ore is outlined and the most valuable deposit is emphasized.
skill.essence_ascendance.pain_purge.desc: Healing also restores unpaid delayed damage, including while current health is full.
skill.essence_ascendance.piercing_projec: Ranged and magical projectiles pierce shields at reduced damage and pass through several enemies, losing damage after each penetration.
skill.essence_ascendance.pocket_nets.des: Rarely grants fishing drops while swimming.
skill.essence_ascendance.potion_duration: Compatible beneficial potions last substantially longer, with diminishing benefit on already long effects.
skill.essence_ascendance.potion_relay.de: Beneficial potion effects applied to the player are shared at reduced duration with nearby allied players and tamed creatures.
skill.essence_ascendance.projectile_drag: Supported hostile projectiles enter a viscous field, visibly slowing all movement including their fall without stopping. The strongest nearby field applies; shots recover when they leave.
skill.essence_ascendance.pure_state.desc: The player cannot receive harmful status effects, sacrificing the ability to reflect them with Status Mirror.
Hits that are completely prevented can still trigger damage reflection, and attempted knockback is echoed back toward its source.
skill.essence_ascendance.restful_mending: Ascendance equipment slowly repairs after going unused for a short time; using it again pauses its repair.
skill.essence_ascendance.ricochet.descri: Ranged and magical projectiles rebound from their first victim toward another nearby enemy.
skill.essence_ascendance.riposte.descrip: After any perfectly timed block, the next melee attack is uninterruptible and gains bonus reach and damage.
skill.essence_ascendance.rising_recovery: Natural regeneration accelerates continuously as health falls, becoming strongest below half health.
Nexus health regeneration and eligible native food regeneration gain the same missing-health multiplier. External healing is unaffected.
skill.essence_ascendance.rooting_payload: Damaging ranged and magical projectile impacts briefly bind the struck enemy, stopping movement and jumps while allowing attacks, turning, and falling. Refreshes and continuing-shot triggers are bounded.
skill.essence_ascendance.running_momentu: Continuous sprinting gradually builds speed; stopping or turning sharply bleeds the bonus away.
skill.essence_ascendance.rush.descriptio: A kill immediately fills Running Momentum and briefly prevents it from decaying.
skill.essence_ascendance.salvagers_craft: Using a grindstone on unwanted equipment recovers a small portion of its base materials and stored enchantment experience.
skill.essence_ascendance.sanctuary.descr: While active, hostile creatures cannot naturally spawn near the player and existing hostiles lose interest faster outside combat.
skill.essence_ascendance.second_wind.des: Lethal damage instead leaves the player at one health, clears queued delayed damage and harmful effects, and grants brief regeneration and strength.
skill.essence_ascendance.shatter.descrip: Killing a frozen enemy consumes its freeze and sprays damaging ice shards into nearby enemies.
skill.essence_ascendance.shattering_ward: When damage breaks the final Soul Ward heart, release a pulse that knocks nearby enemies away and begins rapid regeneration.
skill.essence_ascendance.shield_ram.desc: Sprinting into a creature while guarding staggers it and drives it out of the player's path.
skill.essence_ascendance.soul_ward.descr: Kills add ward hearts based on the victim's vitality; kills made at the ward cap refresh its duration.
skill.essence_ascendance.spirit_walk.des: Lethal damage instead makes the player intangible and harmless for several seconds, allowing normal movement before reforming safely at low health.
Incoming damage is queued and paid evenly over the next ten seconds instead of immediately; delayed ticks cannot be queued again.
skill.essence_ascendance.static_charge.d: Sprinting, falling, flying, or gliding stores charge that the next fully charged attack releases as lightning damage.
skill.essence_ascendance.status_mirror.d: The first harmful status effect received is immediately removed and copied to its source, followed by a cooldown.
skill.essence_ascendance.stored_force.de: Successful blocks store part of the prevented force; the player's next attack expends it for bonus damage and knockback.
skill.essence_ascendance.tempered_repair: Repairing equipment at an anvil or smithing table grants a visible temper buffer that absorbs future durability loss.
skill.essence_ascendance.terrain_freedom: Ignores slowing, sinking, freezing, and contact damage from cobwebs, powder snow, berry bushes, cactus, honey, soul sand, and similar terrain.
skill.essence_ascendance.threat_sense.de: Reveals creatures actively targeting the player, previews dangerous projectile paths, and displays the danger area of primed explosions.
skill.essence_ascendance.tool_instinct.d: Block breaking automatically uses the correct carried Ascendance tool, and higher-tier tools gain extra speed against lower-tier materials.
skill.essence_ascendance.torchbearer.des: While mining, a torch is automatically placed from the hotbar when hostile-spawn darkness reaches your feet.
skill.essence_ascendance.trajectory_thef: Interceptor bats a projectile once toward an eligible aimed enemy, with aim assistance around the projectile, or back to its source. It relaunches at full speed with a homing correction; with no target it is destroyed.
Nearby unopened natural loot containers glow faintly through ordinary terrain.
skill.essence_ascendance.untethered_flig: Flight stamina begins recharging in the air and no longer forces a landing, turning Fatigue Flight into sustained creative-style flight.
skill.essence_ascendance.vector_boost.de: Tapping Jump during an Essence Wings glide spends a rechargeable burst to accelerate along the look direction without fireworks.
skill.essence_ascendance.vector_jump.des: The extra jump becomes a stronger launch along the look direction: upward to climb, forward to accelerate, or downward to brake a fall.
Walking never tramples farmland or fragile eggs and periodically advances the growth of nearby crops.
Villagers offer better prices and nearby villagers regain exhausted trades sooner.
skill.essence_ascendance.water_walking.d: Sprint across liquid surfaces without losing speed; hold Sneak to break through the surface and swim normally.
skill.essence_ascendance.waylight.descri: A personal wisp provides clear night vision, and positions itself above the most spawn-able block near the player.

attunement.essence_ascendance.method.dea: Deal real damage to enemies. Stronger enemies contribute more; repeated legitimate fights still count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.def: Defeat enemies through player-attributed attacks. Player-operated mob farms are valid.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.tak: Survive real incoming damage. Damage attributed directly to yourself does not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.pre: Prevent real incoming damage with shields, armor, resistance or other supported defenses.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.ref: Reflect damage that actually reaches an eligible attacker.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.hea: Recover actual missing health after eligible damage. Healing self-inflicted damage does not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.res: Restore hunger or saturation that was actually missing.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.con: Use hunger or saturation through exertion such as running, swimming, fighting or harvesting.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.res: Reduce a real harmful effect or supported fire, poison or wither impact.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.run: Cover distance while sprinting under your own control. New regions improve efficiency; repeated circuits remain a slower route.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.swi: Cover distance while actively swimming. Riding, idle drift and teleports do not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.fly: Cover distance while gliding or using supported survival flight. Creative flight and teleports do not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.exp: Discover a biome for the first time in this chapter. Discoveries reset after Ascension; exploration is optional.
Reach a dimension for the first time in this chapter. Discoveries reset after Ascension; movement can complete the seal on its own.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.gat: Harvest eligible mining, chopping and digging outputs. Installed value and yield rules apply.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.har: Harvest mature crops yourself. Crop farms and legitimate extra yields count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.cat: Reel in an actual player-attributed catch with eligible value.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.gai: Earn actual experience through eligible gameplay.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.enc: Complete an enchantment. Previewing an offer produces no progress.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.use: Take a completed anvil result with a meaningful change. A repair counts only once within Utility.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.rep: Restore actual missing durability through a supported completed repair.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.tra: Complete a trade. Trading halls and repeated trades remain valid routes.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.bre: Complete a meaningful brew with ingredients you supplied. Merely taking a stored potion does not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.use: Complete a banner pattern using actual inputs.
Complete a meaningful repair or enchantment removal.
Complete a smithing transformation or armor trim.
Complete a stonecutting recipe with meaningful material value.

skill.essence_ascendance.frenzy.descript: Consecutive hits grant +%s%% DMG and +%s%% ATK speed per stack, up to %s stacks.
A miss or %s seconds without a hit breaks the chain. ATK speed also applies to bow draw and caster recovery.
skill.essence_ascendance.armor_crack.des: While Frenzy is active, repeated hits remove %s armor and %s toughness per stack, up to %s stacks.
Changing targets, losing Frenzy, or waiting %s seconds clears the reduction.
skill.essence_ascendance.desperation.des: Gain up to +%s%% DMG as health falls; the bonus scales with your missing-health fraction.
skill.essence_ascendance.death_rush.desc: Kills below %s%% health grant +%s%% melee ATK, +%s%% bow draw and +%s%% caster speed per stack.
Up to %s stacks, each lasting %s seconds. Kills at or below %s%% health refresh all stacks.
skill.essence_ascendance.kindling.descri: Hits add %s Heat; at %s Heat, ignite for %s seconds and amplify your direct hit DMG by %s%% while burning.
Burning deals %s%% of the latest confirmed hit per second. Unfinished Heat expires after %s seconds.
skill.essence_ascendance.combustion.desc: Burning kills explode for %s DMG within %s blocks, hitting up to %s nearby targets without breaking terrain.
Chain reactions retain %s%% DMG per generation, up to %s generations and %s total targets; ignitions last %s seconds.
skill.essence_ascendance.frostbite.descr: Hits add %s Chill toward %s; each stack slows by %s%%, capped at %s%%.
Full Chill freezes for %s seconds at %s%% slow. Unfinished Chill expires after %s seconds.
skill.essence_ascendance.shatter.descrip: Frozen kills release shards for %s DMG to up to %s other targets within %s blocks.
skill.essence_ascendance.static_charge.d: Movement fills %s charge; the next fully charged attack spends a full charge for +%s lightning DMG.
Charge: sprint %s/s, jump %s, fall %s/s, fly %s/s, glide %s/s. After %s idle seconds, lose %s/s.
skill.essence_ascendance.chain_strike.de: Charged lightning jumps to up to %s additional enemies within %s blocks per jump, retaining %s%% DMG each jump.
skill.essence_ascendance.homing_projecti: Projectiles steer toward eligible targets. Bow: %s-block acquisition, %s° cone, %s° turn per tick.
Caster: %s-block acquisition, %s° cone, %s° turn per tick. Values are captured when fired.
skill.essence_ascendance.ricochet.descri: Ranged and caster shots rebound up to %s times toward enemies within %s blocks, retaining %s%% DMG per rebound.
skill.essence_ascendance.piercing_projec: Ranged and caster shots continue through up to %s extra targets, retaining %s%% DMG after each penetration.
Supported shield bypass deals %s%% DMG. Each target is hit only once per shot.
skill.essence_ascendance.explosive_paylo: Projectile impacts explode within %s blocks for %s%% of confirmed hit DMG; up to %s nearby targets and %s payload triggers per shot.
Does not damage terrain or start fires. Secondary explosions cannot trigger more payloads.
skill.essence_ascendance.rooting_payload: Projectile impacts root enemies for %s seconds, with a %s-second refresh cap and %s payload triggers per shot.
Stops movement and jumps, not attacks, turning or falling. After release, recovery immunity lasts %s seconds.
skill.essence_ascendance.projectile_drag: Slow supported hostile projectiles inside %s blocks, reaching %s%% of their speed within %s blocks.
The strongest field applies; projectiles regain speed outside it. Slows falling motion too.
skill.essence_ascendance.interceptor.des: Melee swings at %s%% readiness intercept up to %s supported hostile projectiles within %s blocks.
Swing sweep: %s-block radius and %s° half-angle. Mining is not an intercept swing.
skill.essence_ascendance.trajectory_thef: Intercepted shots relaunch at %s× speed, seeking a target within %s blocks and a %s° aim cone.
Homing turns up to %s° per tick; up to %s ownership transfers. Falls back to the attacker or destroys a shot with no target.
skill.essence_ascendance.guarded_advance: Remove %s%% of guarding slowdown and allow a step height of %s blocks while using a functional shield.
skill.essence_ascendance.shield_ram.desc: Sprinting into a creature while guarding staggers it for %s seconds and adds %s knockback.
Requires %s blocks/tick movement. Staggered movement is %s%% of normal; up to %s contacts, with %s seconds before repeating on a target.
Fully prevented hits can reflect using %s%% of their prevented DMG as the reflection base.
Echo attempted knockback at %s× strength, capped at %s. Uses your existing reflection stats.
skill.essence_ascendance.stored_force.de: Blocks store %s%% of prevented DMG, up to %s force for %s seconds.
The next ready attack spends the force for %s DMG and %s knockback per stored point.
skill.essence_ascendance.guard_amplifier: Successful blocks add %s to the guard amplifier, up to %s×, lasting %s seconds.
A perfect block within %s seconds of raising the shield fills the amplifier.
Reflections also deal %s%% of reflected DMG to up to %s nearby hostile creatures within %s blocks.
skill.essence_ascendance.riposte.descrip: A perfect block arms your next melee attack for %s seconds: +%s%% DMG and +%s blocks reach.
Perfect-block window: %s seconds after raising the shield. The committed strike gains %s seconds of displacement protection.
skill.essence_ascendance.evasive_current: Intentional movement builds up to %s%% dodge over %s seconds; stopping drains it over %s seconds.
A successful dodge spends %s%% of the meter; a taken hit spends %s%%.
Standing still and facing a hostile threat builds up to %s%% DMG resistance over %s seconds; moving or turning drains it over %s seconds.
Threats must be within %s blocks and the %s° facing angle. Knockback immunity starts at %s%% meter.
Repeated hits of one damage type grant %s%% resistance per qualifying stack after %s hits, up to %s total recorded hits.
Maximum resistance: %s%%. A different damage type or %s seconds without that type resets adaptation.
skill.essence_ascendance.status_mirror.d: Remove and reflect the first eligible harmful effect, then wait %s seconds before reflecting again.
Reflected effects are capped at %s seconds and level %s. Reflection requires a valid hostile source.
skill.essence_ascendance.pure_state.desc: Prevent harmful status effects while active, with no cooldown. Replaces Status Mirror rather than reflecting effects.
skill.essence_ascendance.rising_recovery: Natural food and Nexus regeneration accelerate by up to %s× as health falls.
Speed = 1 + %s × (missing-health fraction)^%s. Does not amplify potions or other external healing.
skill.essence_ascendance.life_steal.desc: Confirmed direct weapon hits heal %s%% of DMG, adding %s percentage points per consecutive same-target hit, up to %s hits.
Maximum healing: %s%% of DMG. Changing target, a melee miss or %s seconds without a hit breaks the chain.
skill.essence_ascendance.feast_reflex.de: Food and drink use takes %s%% of normal time. Automatically consumes useful safe hotbar meals without interrupting item use.
While injured, eat toward natural regeneration. With Metabolic Conversion, continue through full hunger until health is full. Healthy meals must waste less than half their nutrition.
skill.essence_ascendance.inner_sustenanc: Outside combat, restore %s hunger and %s saturation every %s seconds, after a %s-second combat recovery lock.
At full hunger and saturation, passive exertion costs stop, sleep is optional and phantoms ignore you. Deliberate resource costs still apply.
skill.essence_ascendance.hunger_ward.des: Redirect %s%% of incoming health DMG into saturation and hunger.
Each food point absorbs %s DMG. Saturation pays first; the unredirected and unpaid portions reach health.
Queue incoming health DMG and pay it evenly over %s seconds instead of immediately.
Delays damage; does not reduce it. Payments cannot trigger defenses again. Unpaid damage survives reconnects and skill changes.
Take %s%% of incoming health DMG after armor, resistance and absorption. Applies to every hit, not a maximum-HP hit cap.

Temporarily lose max HP equal to %s%% of the DMG prevented. After %s seconds without combat, lost hearts return empty. This is not additional or delayed damage; capacity cannot fall below its native minimum or surviving HP.
skill.essence_ascendance.metabolic_conve: Each excess healing point restores %s food points; each nutrition point eaten at full hunger restores %s HP.
Food-generated healing cannot convert back into food. Feast Reflex can keep eating at full hunger while you are injured.
skill.essence_ascendance.pain_purge.desc: Healing also removes %s%% of its amount from unpaid delayed DMG, without reducing the normal healing.
Works with food regeneration, Nexus regeneration, Life Steal and healing effects, including at full HP. Cannot remove more debt than remains or trigger another heal.
skill.essence_ascendance.adrenaline.desc: After a hit actually removes more than %s%% of your pre-hit maximum HP, gain a %s-second surge. Absorption, prevented DMG and max-HP loss do not count.
Surge: +%s%% movement speed, +%s%% ATK speed and +%s%% knockback resistance. Covers melee, bow and caster; refreshes rather than stacks.
gui.essence_ascendance.nexus.skills.tool: Planned skill — gameplay not implemented yet.
skill.essence_ascendance.soul_ward.descr: Kills grant ward HP equal to %s%% of the victim's maximum HP, up to %s%% of your current maximum HP.
Ward hearts last %s seconds; kills refresh the duration even at the cap. Potion absorption stays separate.
skill.essence_ascendance.deep_ward.descr: Increase Soul Ward capacity by +%s%% and retain its hearts during combat instead of expiring.
After %s seconds without hostile combat or a kill, ward hearts decay; a full ward takes %s seconds to empty. Combat pauses decay.
skill.essence_ascendance.shattering_ward: Damage breaking the final Soul Ward heart knocks away up to %s visible enemies within %s blocks, with %s knockback strength.
Regenerate %s%% of your maximum HP per second for %s seconds. Repeated breaks refresh rather than stack regeneration.
Requires surviving the hit. Ward expiry, decay and skill changes do not trigger it; potion hearts do not trigger it.
skill.essence_ascendance.terrain_freedom: Ignore terrain slowing and reduced jumps, cobweb and berry-bush drag, honey sliding, and freezing. Keep firm footing on powder snow, soul sand and mud.
Prevents cactus, berry-bush, magma-block and freezing contact damage. Does not prevent attacks, suffocation, falls, drowning, fire or lava.
skill.essence_ascendance.aquatic_body.de: Restore full native underwater mining efficiency, including while swimming off the ground. See through water with normal scene fog.
Does not boost swimming speed; Swim Speed bonuses and equipment still apply normally. Air supply, drowning, Mining Fatigue and normal tool requirements are unchanged.
skill.essence_ascendance.water_walking.d: Sprint across exposed water and lava surfaces at their natural height. Hold Sneak or stop sprinting to enter the liquid normally.
Enter from shore or above. Does not lift you out of a liquid, place blocks or prevent falling damage. Disabled while riding or flying.
skill.essence_ascendance.lavaborn.descri: Swim through lava using your normal swimming speed and see through its surfaces from inside. While immersed, lava and ordinary fire contact cannot hurt you.
Lava cannot ignite you, so leaving it does not cause lingering lava burns. Unrelated fire is not extinguished; attacks and damage outside immersion remain normal.
hud.essence_ascendance.mobility.vector_j: Tap Jump; look to launch or brake
Reduces falling and movement-impact damage by %s%%, including wall collisions and landing on pointed dripstone.

Your existing player and equipment Fall Resistance also protects against other movement impacts, alongside native fall-damage multipliers. Fall Resistance is applied once; attacks and administrative damage are unaffected.
skill.essence_ascendance.charged_jump.de: Hold Jump on solid ground to charge over %s seconds, then release for up to %sx your native upward jump launch.
Movement keys steer the leap. Releasing early gives a smaller jump; leaving the ground, opening a screen, or changing movement mode cancels the charge.
skill.essence_ascendance.double_jump.des: Release and tap Jump again in midair for one extra jump with %sx your native upward launch. Movement keys choose its direction.
Landing on solid ground restores the extra jump. Holding Jump does not repeat it. Swimming, climbing, gliding, flight, riding, and teleports reset it.
skill.essence_ascendance.vector_jump.des: Replaces Double Jump with one look-directed air launch, using %sx your native jump impulse. Look upward to climb or forward to accelerate.
Looking downward brakes instead of diving: up to %s%% of existing falling velocity is removed when looking straight down. Reduced fall momentum lowers accumulated fall damage.
Release and tap Jump again to activate; landing restores the shared air jump. This replaces Double Jump, never adds another charge.
skill.essence_ascendance.tool_instinct.d: Automatically uses the best carried Ascendance mining tool. Against lower-tier materials, the generated speed bonus can reach %s%%.
The resolved tool is used by vanilla harvesting, so its enchantments, durability, drops, and normal mod hooks still apply.
skill.essence_ascendance.mining_momentum: Continuous mining builds to +%s%% mining speed over %s same-material breaks.
Changing material preserves %s%% of build rate; the rhythm breaks after %s seconds without a successful block break.
skill.essence_ascendance.natures_boon.de: Eligible dimension-native stone has a %s%% chance to produce an additional ore drop.
Ore candidates come from dimension/convention tags, are weighted by the procedural economy, and use their native loot with the tool that performed the harvest.
skill.essence_ascendance.torchbearer.des: After mining, automatically places a supported light at your feet only when the current dimension's hostile-spawn lighting rules consider that position dark enough.
Checks the exact block at your feet, then preserves normal placement and consumption for vanilla torches, c:torches, and essence_ascendance:torchbearer_lights.
